message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (June 18 1815) resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties**—killed, wounded, and missing combined. A commonly cited breakdown is:

| Side | Casualties |
|------|------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~12,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~13,000 |

These figures are estimates; contemporary reports varied, but most historians agree on a total in the mid‑20‑thousand range.
